speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma. The patient's history of heavy smoking, non-healing red crusty lesions on the penis and finger, lack of response to syphilis/eczema treatments, and the specific description of induration/bleeding strongly point to cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. The requested CBC, ESR, and ACE were appropriate to rule out sarcoidosis and systemic infection, but the clinical picture confirms malignancy.
